system.description: The Stormkelt reaches out with their arms stretched toward the sky and calls upon Sunvei. The dimwalker’s hands then begin to glow with a purifying fire that the S tormkelt lowers toward an injured character. Scar tissue immediately appears over the places where the fire has purified the body. ✦ Heals 3 Body Points and stops any bleeding.
system.summary: The Stormkelt reaches out with their arms stretched toward the sky and calls upon Sunvei.
